usedFor: Encharge holds people and tags, and Hastewire rewrites text through “Humanize Text” whenever “Tag Added To Person” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Tag Added To Person” in Encharge, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A tagged person starts a rewrite that makes text sound natural, ready for your next message.

watchOut: “Updated Person” fires on every edit, so the same person can run “Humanize Text” again.
